reason: Response 1 is more practically actionable for this team: it gives concrete mechanical send constraints including exfiltration controls, works within the 14-day limit (a metadata-only decision trace and the user's mailbox as the durable record), and adds shadow mode, cross-account authorization checks and concrete go/no-go criteria, while Response 2 covers similar ground but contradicts itself on scheduling and spends more space on performative hedging.
